mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the difference between current and 3-month-ago values) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 2.5%, it signals a highly accommodative monetary policy that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.5, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly industrial production (INDPRO) signals a deepening recession, which is typically followed by a market rebound as the worst is priced in, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate is negative and INDPRO monthly change is negative, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economy characterized by a low unemployment rate (below 4.0%) and rising unemployment (indicating labor market tightening), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0 and rising, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive monthly change in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals improving labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased month-over-month, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) above 1300 thousand units signals a strengthening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is above 1300, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong retail sales growth (RSAFS growth rate > 0.5%) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%) signals a favorable economic environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS growth rate exceeds 0.5% and FEDFUNDS is below 3.0, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (the 2017 base) signals a severe contraction in manufacturing, which is typically followed by a market rebound as the worst is priced in, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 100, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
